features: 🎮 2-in-1 Mini Keyboard with Touchpad ParuhT wireless mini keyboard combines a compact QWERTY keyboard and responsive touchpad mouse for smooth typing, scrolling, and navigation on Smart TVs, PCs, laptops, tablets, and Android TV devices.

📡 Dual Wireless Connectivity Supports both Bluetooth and 2.4GHz USB receiver modes for stable and fast wireless performance. Easily connect with Smart TVs, Fire TV Stick, Windows PCs, Android devices, laptops, and more.
🌈 RGB Backlit Keys for Night Use Colorful LED backlit keys improve visibility in low-light environments, making it ideal for gaming, movie streaming, nighttime browsing, and home theater setups.

🎒 Ultra-Portable & Ergonomic Design Compact handheld design fits comfortably in your hand or pocket, making the ParuhT mini wireless keyboard perfect for travel, presentations, classrooms, gaming, and couch control.

🔋 Rechargeable & Wide Compatibility Built-in rechargeable battery offers long-lasting use with convenient USB charging. Compatible with Windows, Android, Linux, Mac OS, Smart TVs, tablets, smartphones, HTPC, and TV boxes.
description: Upgrade your entertainment and productivity experience with the ParuhT Mini Wireless Keyboard with Touchpad. Designed for seamless control, this compact 2-in-1 keyboard combines a responsive mini keyboard and precision touchpad in one portable device. Whether you're browsing on your Smart TV, controlling your Android TV Box, streaming with a Fire TV Stick, or working on a laptop or tablet, ParuhT delivers smooth wireless performance with both Bluetooth and 2.4GHz connectivity. The vibrant LED backlit keys make typing easy even in dark environments, perfect for movie nights, gaming sessions, presentations, and late-night browsing. Its ergonomic handheld design ensures comfortable use from your couch, desk, or while traveling. With wide compatibility across Windows, Android, Mac, Linux, Smart TVs, tablets, and smartphones, the ParuhT mini keyboard is the ideal portable remote companion for home entertainment and productivity.
